entities.summary: Dean Michael Evans is a former field hockey player from Australia, who was a member of the team that won the silver medal at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona, Spain. Dean was also a member of the Australian Men's field hockey team in 1986 when they won gold at the World Cup for the first time.
